children: GRI Bio reported Phase 2a translational biomarker and safety data for GRI-0621 showing a placebo‑adjusted Week 12 FVC gain of +99 mL overall and +139 mL on background antifibrotic therapy.
Posted updated corporate presentation and furnished press release announcing new translational biomarker data from Phase 2a GRI-0621‑IPF‑02.
Phase 2a (N=35, 12-week) showed concordant signals across RNA‑seq, serum ECM biomarkers, spectral flow and clinical readouts defining nine mechanistic pillars.
Placebo‑adjusted FVC change at Week 12: +99 mL overall; +139 mL on background standard‑of‑care antifibrotic therapy (exploratory, not powered).
Safety favorable: no drug‑related serious AEs, less cough (0% vs 25%), dyspnea (4% vs 17%) and diarrhea (17% vs 33%) vs placebo despite higher nintedanib use in active arm.
Company views totality of Phase 2a data as supportive to advance GRI-0621 into a longer‑duration (e.g., 52‑week) study including with background antifibrotics.
